lessons.title: Practice Whitespace Tokenize
lessons.description: Implement tokenize(text) splitting on whitespace and dropping empties. The test checks that tokenize(' hello world ') equals ['hello', 'world'].
learning_objectives: Depot potters recount crates before dawn, and tokenize text on whitespace.
lessons.solution_code:
def tokenize(text):
    return [t for t in text.split() if t]

source.name: Python official documentation (docs.python.org) — Text Sequence Type str — str.split() with no arguments splits on whitespace

lessons.title: Encode Sequence
lessons.description: Implement encode(tokens, vocab, unk_id) mapping unknown tokens to unk_id. The test checks that encode(['a', 'z'], {'a': 1}, 0) equals [1, 0].
learning_objectives: Plaza potters recount crates before dawn, and encode tokens to ids.
lessons.solution_code:
def encode(tokens, vocab, unk_id):
    return [vocab.get(t, unk_id) for t in tokens]

source.name: Python official documentation (docs.python.org) — Mapping Types — dict.get(key, default) for unknown-token fallback

lessons.title: Practice Checkpoint Sliding Windows
lessons.description: Implement ngrams(tokens, n) returning list of n-length tuples. The test checks that ngrams(['a', 'b', 'c'], 2) equals [('a', 'b'), ('b', 'c')].
learning_objectives: Marsh potters recount crates before dawn, and generate n-grams.
lessons.solution_code:
def ngrams(tokens, n):
    return [tuple(tokens[i:i + n]) for i in range(len(tokens) - n + 1)]
